agents.note: US-455 CLOSED (passes:true) -- unit-string canonicalization (D-4/F-082, size S), commit ff1cf20. Decoder-path units now emit the python-obd NATIVE string so a physical unit has ONE canonical label across both write paths (legacy path already stores str(response.unit)=native via logger.py:490-502; the decoder was overriding it with a hand-written abbreviation). MAPPING 'V'->'volt' (BATTERY_V + O2_B1S2), 'kPa'->'kilopascal' (BAROMETRIC_KPA), 's'->'second' (RUNTIME_SEC). GROUNDING: python-obd is NOT installed in the dev env, so the native strings are grounded in the decoder test fixtures which feed the native unit as the decoder INPUT ('volt' test_decoders_v2:175, 'kilopascal' :157, 'second' :136) and the decoder discarded it for the abbreviation. Two REAL collisions in polled data justify the set (both params in pollingTiers): voltage (legacy O2_B1S1 'volt' vs decoder 'V') + pressure (legacy INTAKE_PRESSURE 'kilopascal' vs decoder 'kPa'); seconds aligns to the same native rule so DISTINCT unit is uniformly canonical. Lockstep: 5 test assertions (test_decoders_v2 x4 + test_logger_v2_decoders x1) + 4 faithful BATTERY_V mock fixtures (idle-poll x2 + lifecycle/warm-restart e2e x2 -- fixture noise, unit not asserted, updated for a clean zero-remaining grep per US-454 rename discipline).
